title: Minimax and alpha-beta on an oware position
instructions:
## Three moves, three replies

An oware program is choosing a move. It can sow from house **B**, **C** or **D**. For each, the opponent has three replies, and the program scores each final position: seeds ahead after two moves. You (MAX) want the score high and the opponent (MIN) wants it low.

## Do this

1. Run **Minimax**: every leaf is evaluated, each MIN node takes its smallest child and the root takes the largest.
2. Run **Alpha-beta pruning** on the same tree. Watch α and β in the Variables panel, and note which leaves are never looked at.
hints: After B, α = 4 at the root. In C the first leaf is 3, below α, so MAX will never choose C: the rest of C is pruned.
In D, 6 is above α but 2 is not: D3 is pruned.

realityNote: With good move ordering, alpha-beta searches about twice as deep as minimax in the same time, which is how chess and draughts programs reached master strength.
